description: A window call written in the ORDER BY of a query with an EXPLICIT GROUP BY is refused, and refused whatever its keys name: a group key, a SELECT alias, an aggregate and an ungrouped column all get the same answer, so this is a rule about the CLAUSE rather than about scope. A window nested inside a larger key expression is refused too - the CALL is what is refused. Two neighbours stay legal and are asserted here so the rule cannot widen by accident: ordering by a window the SELECT LIST carries, which is an ordinary reference to a projected column, and a window in the ORDER BY of an IMPLICITLY aggregated query, which live runs because that query has exactly one row and no ordering of it can change anything. Live re-prints the call canonicalised where this prints it as written, so the cases assert the sentence around the brackets. Converted 1:1 from query/GroupedOrderByWindowTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE g (a INT, b INT, c INT)
SELECT a, SUM(b) s FROM g GROUP BY a ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c)

error.messageContains: is not a valid order by expression

steps.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) s FROM g GROUP BY a ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s)

error.messageContains: is not a valid order by expression

steps.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) s FROM g GROUP BY a ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a)

error.messageContains: is not a valid order by expression

steps.sql: SELECT a, SUM(b) s FROM g GROUP BY a ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(c))

error.messageContains: is not a valid order by expression

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE g (a INT, b INT, c INT)
SELECT a, SUM(b) s FROM g GROUP BY a ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a) + 1

error.messageContains: is not a valid order by expression

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE g (a INT, b INT, c INT)
SELECT a, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a) r FROM g GROUP BY a ORDER BY r
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE g (a INT, b INT, c INT)
SELECT SUM(b) FROM g ORDER BY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 1)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE g (a INT, b INT, c INT)
SELECT a, SUM(b) s FROM g GROUP BY a ORDER BY a
SELECT a, SUM(b) s FROM g GROUP BY a ORDER BY SUM(b)
